findings: AI classifier truncates category list to first 51 to match generated index range 0...50, then validates returned index against usable categories. Categories beyond that limit are unavailable without an explicit diagnostic.
Generation constrains confidence to 0...100 but reason length, filename, excerpt and category guide lengths are not bounded here. Caller extraction limits remain to be reviewed.

Availability reports distinguish disabled, ineligible, model-not-ready, old system and unknown states. classify checks platform/module availability but does not require availability.isReady before making the model request; errors propagate to caller.

A fresh local content-tagging model session is constructed per request. No explicit timeout, concurrency budget or Task cancellation policy is visible in these functions. No model inference was executed.
Model output is a classification suggestion, not duplicate evidence or content equality. Confidence is generated rather than empirically calibrated in this source.
